Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager

Interface ManagerListener

public interface ManagerListener
Receives the events of a DatabaseManager, as opposed to the events of one connection.

Every method has an empty default body, so an implementation overrides only what it needs. A listener is registered with DatabaseManager.Builder.managerListener(ManagerListener).

A listener must not call the manager, for any connection name. It runs while a holder lock is held, so two listeners that ask for each other's connection on different threads can deadlock.

Implementation Requirements:
An implementation must be safe to call from any thread that asks the manager for a connection, and should return quickly, because it runs while that connection is being built.

  • Method Details

    • connectionEstablished

      default void connectionEstablished(ConnectionEstablished event)
      Called after the manager built a connection and attached its listeners, before any caller can see the connection.

      It fires again when a connection is built anew after purge, disconnect or reconnect. The listener may use the event's connection, but must not ask the manager for the connection being built: that throws IllegalStateException.

      Parameters:
      event - the connection that was built, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the manager then closes the new connection and the failure reaches the caller that asked for it, and the next call builds again
